title: lycopodium annotinum subsp. alpestre
intro: Lycopodium annotinum subsp. alpestre, commonly known as Stag's Horn Club Moss, is a type of plant belonging to the Lycopodiaceae family. It is a low-growing, evergreen perennial with long stems and branches. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Stag's Horn Club Moss include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and supporting respiratory health.
